title: 12 Best Art Galleries in Accra
description: Discover Accra's thriving art scene! Explore the top 12 art galleries, from traditional African masterpieces to cutting-edge contemporary works. Find your next inspiration in Ghana's vibrant capital.

places.name: Artists Alliance Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry; art pieces GHS 500 - GHS 50,000+ / $40 - $4,000+
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for works by established Ghanaian masters and explore the diverse collection across all three floors, especially the vibrant street scenes.

places.name: Gallery 1957
places.priceRange: Free entry; art pieces GHS 2,000 - GHS 100,000+ / $160 - $8,000+
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their website for current exhibitions. Expect thought-provoking contemporary works that push artistic boundaries.

places.name: Nubuke Foundation
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Wander through the sculpture garden, check out the current exhibition, and inquire about any ongoing workshops or events.

places.name: The Loom Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry; art pieces GHS 300 - GHS 25,000+ / $25 - $2,000+
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for established Ghanaian painters and vibrant textile art that reflects local traditions.

places.name: Brazil House
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Immerse yourself in the historical exhibits and look for contemporary pieces by local Jamestown artists that reflect the community's heritage.

places.name: Noldor Artist Residency (The Noldor Art Gallery)
places.priceRange: Free entry; art pieces GHS 1,500 - GHS 50,000+ / $120 - $4,000+
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the current exhibition, as it's always featuring fresh talent and innovative works.

places.name: Alliance Française Accra
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their monthly program for exhibition schedules. They often feature photography, painting, and mixed media installations.

places.name: ADA Contemporary Art Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry; art pieces GHS 5,000 - GHS 200,000+ / $400 - $16,000+
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Experience cutting-edge contemporary art. Their exhibitions are often thoughtfully curated and visually striking.

places.name: Untamed Empire
places.priceRange: Entry to events varies; art pieces GHS 200 - GHS 10,000+ / $15 - $800+
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Attend one of their themed art events or pop-up exhibitions to experience a fusion of art, music, and fashion.

places.name: Accra Arts Centre
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bargain for intricately carved wooden figures, vibrant kente cloth, or unique paintings by local artists.

places.name: Foundation for Contemporary Art - Ghana (FCA)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Attend their exhibition openings or artist talks to engage with the concepts behind the contemporary works.

places.name: Jamestown Cafe & Gallery
places.priceRange: Free entry; art pieces GHS 100 - GHS 5,000 / $8 - $400
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a local meal or snack while browsing the artworks on display. Support local artists by purchasing a piece.
